title: The owner's decisions of 2026-10-15: Claude Sonnet 5.5 as the product's model, retention, readers and blind labelling
request: Switch the product's models from OpenAI to Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5; keep collecting training data without training; confirm retention (events 24 months, model text 12), readers of sessions (owner and admin) and blind labelling (the owner first), and show how to label.
spec: Every product model purpose served by the Messages API without changing a caller; no key sent to another host; euro caps still able to stop a request; the owner's decisions as the defaults; a labelling path that never forces a guess.
plan: Read the gateway, its settings, prices and transports.
Write a Messages API transport translating OpenAI-style messages and tools both ways.
Switch the standard tier by one setting; keep a tier's own endpoint.
Price Sonnet from the provider's page.
Make retention's defaults the owner's numbers.
Add a skip to blind labelling and write the labelling guide.

decisions.decision: A native Messages API transport, not Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
decisions.why: Tool use and structured outputs are the provider's own there; the compatible endpoint is meant for trying models.

decisions.decision: The embedding purpose is not offered on Anthropic; evidence search stays lexical.
decisions.why: The provider has no embeddings, and the measured choice was the lexical method.

decisions.decision: The research campaign stays on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and says so.
decisions.why: It is a research tool outside the product's gateway.

decisions.decision: A reviewer who cannot tell skips; the decision stays drawn and unlabelled.
decisions.why: A reported gap is honest; a guess biases every measurement made with it.

decisions.decision: Retention's numbers became the defaults, with zero turning a class off.
decisions.why: The owner confirmed them as the policy.

change: dclab_rnd/models/anthropic_client.py (new), settings.py, gateway.py, client.py, prices.py; secret_files.py; routers intern and runs; model_paths.py and decision_model_compare.py; experience/retention.py; accounts/roles.py; ledger/labels.py, pages/ledger.py and the Admin page (rebuilt); tests/test_anthropic_transport.py (new), run_parallel.py, the model tests' clean environments, test_consent.py, test_decision_labels.py; Makefile, requirements, .env.example, docs/guides/BLIND_LABELLING.md (new), ROADMAP.md, CLAUDE.md.

findings.defect: The owner's provider setting reached the model tests.
findings.scenario: After the switch was written to .env, thirty tests of two files failed on their tier assertions.
findings.cause: The server module reads .env at import, and the tests cleared only the OpenAI settings.
findings.fix: The parallel runner and the test targets blank the provider settings; the shared clean environments do too.

findings.defect: The retention test expected retention off when unset.
findings.scenario: With the owner's defaults, an unset setting deletes events older than two years.
findings.cause: The test was written before the owner chose.
findings.fix: Zero turns a class off; unset applies the owner's days; both tested.

findings.defect: No credit and an overload inside a stream were told as an unknown failure.
findings.scenario: Every turn was sent again and refused again, and an overload was never retried.
findings.cause: The classifier read only the error code and type.
findings.fix: A credit-balance refusal pauses as no credit; an overload is a provider error, retried.

findings.defect: Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible address and a Claude tier without a model were handled wrongly.
findings.scenario: The compatible address got the Messages API at a doubled path and paused for ten minutes; the strong tier at Anthropic's host got an OpenAI model name.
findings.cause: The provider was read from the host alone and the model from the standard tier.
findings.fix: Only the host without a path is the Messages API; a Claude tier without a model gets Claude.

findings.defect: A request without a limit was cut at a lower limit than the cost estimate assumed.
findings.scenario: A long critique sent without a limit stopped mid JSON.
findings.cause: The transport kept its own default.
findings.fix: The transport sends the limit the estimate assumes, one shared constant.

findings.defect: The free local checks stayed on the provider of .env.
findings.scenario: The local model comparison stopped with the tier not local.
findings.cause: Their overrides set the OpenAI settings only.

findings.defect: Pages still named the OpenAI key.
findings.scenario: The intern told the owner to set the OpenAI key when the Claude key was missing.
findings.cause: The note was written for one provider.
findings.fix: The note follows the provider; the campaign says it needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

findings.defect: The serial and agent test targets read .env too.
findings.scenario: A serial run would read the owner's provider.
findings.cause: Only the parallel runner blanked it.
findings.fix: The test targets export the provider settings empty.

findings.defect: A dated Claude model had no price.
findings.scenario: A snapshot name would run with no euro cap able to stop it.
findings.cause: Prices were matched by exact name.
findings.fix: A dated snapshot takes its alias's price.

measurements.name: tests
measurements.gate: the model tests and the new transport tests pass with no live call
measurements.result: the transport, gateway, management, data limits, intern and shadow test files pass offline; no model was called
limits: No live request was sent: the key is the owner's to add.

outcome: Claude Sonnet 5.5 serves the product once the owner adds the key; retention runs by the owner's numbers; blind labelling can be skipped and has a guide.
lessons: A setting in the owner's .env is part of every test unless the runner blanks it.
Read the provider from the whole address, not the host alone.
A cost estimate is an upper bound only when the request is sent with the limit it assumed.
risks: No live request has been made to Claude yet.
The research campaign still needs an OpenAI-compatible key.
